en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand historic city hall building with a tall clock tower dominating a public square filled with horse‑drawn carriages and people. Smaller buildings and a church‑like structure frame the square. The front has the printed captions "Pécs" at the upper left and "Városháza" at the upper right. The reverse side is a standard divided‑back postcard layout with vertical Hungarian text along the left indicating a Budapest publisher and a small boxed logo with the letters "K. R." near the bottom.
